yogas.name: Gaja Kesari Yoga
yogas.description: Jupiter in Kendra from Moon. Bestows wisdom, wealth, and fame.

yogas.name: Budhaditya Yoga
yogas.description: Sun and Mercury conjoined. Gives sharp intellect and communication skills.

yogas.name: Vipareeta Raja Yoga
yogas.description: Dusthana lord conjoined or placed in another dusthana house: 6th Lord (Saturn) in House 8, 8th Lord (Mars) in House 6. Neutralizes adversity and brings sudden rise, unexpected gains, and stellar resilience.

yogas.name: Sunapha Yoga
yogas.description: Planets occupy the 2nd house from the Moon. Bestows mental strength, self-earned wealth, fame, and a prosperous, comfortable life.

yogas.name: Adhi Yoga
yogas.description: Natural benefics (Jupiter) occupy the 6th, 7th, or 8th houses from the Moon. Grants high status, fame, prosperity, leadership, and a highly influential life.

yogas.name: Vasi Yoga
yogas.description: Planets occupy the 12th house from the Sun: Venus. Confers intellectual dexterity, physical resilience, artistic talent, and respected fame.

yogas.name: Shankha Yoga
yogas.description: 5th Lord (Saturn) and 6th Lord (Saturn) occupy mutual Kendra houses. Bestows scholastic mastery, profound philosophical and humanitarian pursuits, high morality, and wealth.

sade_sati.description: Saturn is not currently transiting the 12th, 1st, or 2nd houses from your Moon. You are not currently going through Sade Sati.
